name: Malubeth the Scourger

abilities.name: Ethereal Bolt
abilities.description: A basic ranged attack that does high magic damage.

abilities.name: Scourging Spark
abilities.description: The boss places blue magical areas under two random players dealing continuous direct moderate magic damage and snaring. This attack persists for a long time, and thus players should kill the boss quickly before the entire floor gets covered.

abilities.name: Rend Soul
abilities.description: The boss picks up a random player as indicated by purple beams connecting the boss and player. In this stage, the boss is invulnerable, and the player takes direct moderate-high magic damage every second, is stunned and cannot break free. The other party members must activate the two altars at the side to free the trapped player. If the trapped player isn't freed in 10 seconds, they are executed with oblivion damage. This attack cannot be escaped using Precognition.

summary: This article is about the creature. For the item set, see Scourge Harvester. Malubeth the Scourger is a large harvester summoned by Master Pellingare. She serves as the first boss of Wayrest Sewers II. Her unique drop is Malubeth's Stinger. She is also the namesake of the Scourge Harvester set, but doesn't drop any pieces. When she is approached, she will shout "You'll not leave here alive." The Journal of Garron is found in front of her.
